title: An overview of HTTP
note: Understand HTTP fundamentals, request and response cycles, methods, headers, status codes, and how web communication works.

title: Database Reference
note: Learn relational database fundamentals, SQL queries, indexing, transactions, constraints, and database performance.

title: Reverse Proxy
note: Understand reverse proxies, how they sit between clients and backend servers, and how they support load balancing, security, and performance.

title: Latency
note: Explore techniques for reducing system latency, including caching, connection reuse, asynchronous processing, database optimization, and network efficiency.

title: Cloud Design Patterns
note: Get an overview of common cloud architecture patterns and understand the problems they solve in scalable and distributed applications.

title: Cache Aside Pattern
note: Understand the cache-aside pattern, cache misses, cache population, expiration, and strategies for improving application read performance.

title: Publisher-Subscriber Pattern
note: Learn how publishers and subscribers communicate through events, enabling asynchronous processing and loose coupling between services.

title: gRPC Core Concepts
note: Understand gRPC communication, Protocol Buffers, RPC calls, streaming, deadlines, and communication between distributed services.

title: Timeouts, Retries and Exponential Backoff
note: Learn how timeouts, retry limits, and exponential backoff help handle transient failures without overwhelming dependent services.

title: Adding Jitter to Exponential Backoff
note: Understand how random delays (jitter) prevent synchronized retry attempts and reduce traffic spikes during service failures.

title: Rate Limiting Pattern
note: Learn how to control incoming request rates, protect backend services, enforce quotas, and prevent excessive API usage.

title: Throttling Pattern
note: Understand how throttling controls resource consumption under heavy workloads and protects systems from overload.

title: Idempotent Consumer Pattern
note: Learn how to safely process duplicate messages and requests while ensuring that repeated operations do not cause unintended side effects.

title: CDN, DDoS Protection and Security
note: Understand content delivery networks, edge caching, DDoS mitigation, and how distributed infrastructure improves application availability and security.

title: Application Security
note: Build familiarity with application security terminology, common vulnerabilities, secure development practices, and important security concepts.

title: Continuous Integration (CI)
note: Learn how automated builds and tests validate code changes and help maintain software quality through continuous integration.

title: Continuous Deployment (CD)
note: Understand automated deployment workflows, deployment environments, release pipelines, and how applications are delivered reliably.

title: Monitoring, Alerts, SLOs, Overload, Incidents and Releases
note: Explore production reliability practices, service level objectives, monitoring, alerting, incident management, overload handling, and safe releases.
